sectionDescription: Configure allowed or blocked IP address ranges
placeholderAllowlist:
Enter allowed IP addresses, one per line, CIDR supported
Example: 192.168.1.0/24
helperAllowlist: Leave empty to allow all IPs. Supports single IP or CIDR format, one per line.
placeholderBlocklist:
Enter blocked IP addresses, one per line, CIDR supported
Example: 10.0.0.0/8
helperBlocklist: Blocklist has higher than allowlist. Supports single IP or CIDR format, one per line.
alertContent: IP access control affects access permissions for all users. Enable only when necessary and review regularly.
